name: Pull to Refresh
hint: Pull the feed down slowly: a droplet stretches from the edge, snaps free at the threshold, then spins and bursts into a check.
description: A pull-to-refresh control made of liquid, for React Native. Pulling draws a droplet down from the list's edge: it swells while its neck thins under a tension curve that gets heavier the further you pull. At the threshold the neck snaps with a haptic tick and the drop breaks free with a wobble. On release three beads orbit inside it while the list holds open, then it bursts into a check with a success haptic as new items drop in on top. Reduce Motion keeps the drop but swaps the orbit and wobble for a gentle pulse; a hidden button refreshes for screen readers.
intents: activity feed that loads new items
usage: Use on feeds and lists whose content changes on the server. Keep refreshes short and say what changed (the count of new items). On long lists, also refresh automatically when the screen comes back into view.
